content:
Have a look at the folder setting for the account and check if outbox is selected as the auto-select folder. This setting opens a specified folder by default each time the account is selected.

Settings > account name > folders: Auto-select folder. The typical value is none, or inbox.

Is the account with said outbox the first account in the list. With Unified Inbox disabled, the first account is selected by default when the app opens.
